name: Pylon
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: B2B customer support platform built for Slack and Microsoft Teams. Manage tickets, track issues, and deliver white-glove support directly where your clients chat.
best_for: B2B SaaS teams supporting customers in shared Slack/Teams channels who want tickets, accounts and AI in one B2B-native platform
skip_if: you run classic B2C email/chat support (Zendesk-class tools are cheaper at volume), or Pylon's unpublished seat minimum for new customers exceeds your team
honest_knock: The seat price is only part of the bill: AI agents run on credits that sales prices, phone adds $35 a seat and SSO on Advanced adds $125 a month, so model the full basket before you compare. Its B2B-native design (Slack and Teams first, account-based views) is a genuine fit gap that classic ticket tools fake with workarounds.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Professional · per seat a month on an annual contract
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-20 on usepylon.com/pricing, usepylon.com/pylon-facts and usepylon.com/llms.txt) Pylon publishes rates again. Professional is $89 per seat a month and Advanced $139 per seat a month, both on an annual contract; Enterprise is a custom quote. Pylon's facts page (updated 10 November 2026) says monthly billing is also available but prints no monthly rate, and says there is a minimum seat count for new customers without giving the number. Viewer seats appear in all three tiers. AI agents (Assist Agent, Support Agent, Slack Agent, Automations) run on credits instead of a per-seat AI add-on: you buy them pay as you go or as a yearly commitment, and committed packages start at 5,000 credits a year according to llms.txt. No credit price is published; sales estimates the volume, and the pricing page has a calculator that asks for tickets per month, the share you want automated and the share that needs deep investigation. Priced add-ons: Phone at $35 per seat a month, Account Intelligence at $10 per customer account a month, and SAML SSO at $125 a month on Advanced (included in Enterprise). Free trials exist but are set up through sales; there is no free plan. History: from 1 September to at least 11 October 2026 the pricing page was a demo booking form with no rates, and llms.txt returned a 404. Before that it listed Starter at about $59, Professional at about $89 and Enterprise at about $139 per seat, with a three-seat minimum on the first two and seven seats on Enterprise, plus AI agents from about $100 a month and an AI assistant at about $50 a seat. Starter is gone, $139 now buys Advanced instead of Enterprise, and Pylon's own facts page calls the $50 and $100 AI figures outdated.

open_questions.question: Do Viewer and Integration User seats cost the same as a Member seat?
What does one credit cost, and how many credits does a typical ticket use?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Which plans can be bought month to month, and at what price?

Our price check could not put a number on this part of the cost: AI agent credits have no published price, and add-ons (Phone at $35 per seat a month, Account Intelligence at $10 per customer account a month, SAML SSO at $125 a month on Advanced) are not in the estimate. Can you publish the price or the rule?
